Method of Attack: Privilege escalation via security misconfiguration and validation check bug allowing unauthenticated attackers to create administrator accounts
Uploading backdoors capable of executing commands, injecting ads, or redirecting traffic
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using Houzez Theme plugin
WordPress sites using Houzez Login Register plugin
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation without authentication via crafted requests to account creation endpoints
Exploitation of validation check bug on server side
